snippet.title: 7Komada | Official Trailer | Free Demo on Steam Oct 15
snippet.description:
http://store.steampowered.com/app/4760770/7Komada

https://memorandumteleoptik.org/7komada/

7KOMADA is a 3D detective, talk-em-up VN about 18 teenagers in the fictionalized nation of Illyria, who wake up to find themselves trapped in a mansion. Forced to compete in a team-based ‘Killing Game’ inspired by classic social deduction experiences such as Werewolf and Mafia, they say and do bad things to each other. They do even worse things to themselves, because that’s the only thing any of them are given the freedom to do.
